title.fr: Pression en un point d'un liquide (hydrostatique)

sketch:
Observe: SVG canvas showing a tall transparent tank filled with
liquid. Sliders: liquid density ρ (dropdown: water, oil, mercury),
depth h of a pressure probe (draggable vertically). HUD:
p = p_atm + ρ·g·h (Pa or bar). Small pressure gauge on the probe
shows current reading. Side view of tank with pressure vs. depth
line (linear, slope ρg). Experiment: reach target pressure by
choosing liquid + depth. Evaluate: gauge hidden; student picks depth
blindly for a target p. Wrinkle: p_atm ≈ 10⁵ Pa baked in; densities
in kg/m³; g = 10. "Pressure at depth h is the same everywhere at
depth h regardless of container shape" surprise is highlighted.
